items.title: 3 US Stocks Riding The AI Data Center Power And Cooling Buildout
items.summary: AI is burning through compute and power, and the Anthropic IPO, Nvidia leadership questions, and fresh regulatory scrutiny have pushed that reality into sharp focus for investors. Money chasing AI is not just flowing into model developers; it is pulling attention toward the digital plumbing behind them.
